subject: Re: Deployment mode pricing follow-up — AcmeHealth
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: deployment mode & next steps

Thanks again for taking the call today, Samantha — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

Call notes:
- Primary use case: conversational virtual assistant for clinical intake and patient triage (chat-heavy).
- Target production traffic: ~100 RPS average, with bursts to ~400 RPS.
- Estimated tokens: ~10M tokens/day (approx 300M tokens/month).
- Target latency: 200ms p95 for assistant responses.
- Compliance: SOC 2 required; possibility of VPC/private deployment later in the year.

Deployment modes we discussed:
1) Hosted API — fastest to production, pay-as-you-go per-token billing. Good if you want quick launch and no infra ops.
2) Dedicated capacity — reserved GPU pools with predictable throughput and lower unit cost for sustained high volume. Recommended when you need predictable latency and cost savings at scale.
3) Private (VPC / on-prem) — for regulated workloads needing full network isolation and on-prem control. Higher setup and recurring infra costs.

Ask / next steps:
- Can you confirm the 10M tokens/day estimate and whether that’s expected to grow?
- Do you have a target commit range (monthly $ or token commit) you’d consider for a Dedicated reserved plan?
- Any specific model preference (open checkpoint, LLM size) or is fidelity/latency the priority?

I attached a quick initial_estimate.xlsx with rough per-token vs reserved scenarios. Dev is looped on sizing questions; if you’re open we can provide a tight cost comparison (+ assumptions) by Wednesday.

Thanks — I’ll wait for the confirm on tokens and commit ranges and then pull pricing scenarios together.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: initial_estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: Samantha Green <samantha@acmehealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T17:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: deployment mode & next steps

Hi Aditya — thanks for the recap, that looks right. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The 10M tokens/day is our current go-live projection; we anticipate 15–20% month-over-month growth during the first quarter post-launch.
- Latency target is firm: ~200ms p95. We’d consider slightly higher if it materially reduces cost, but preference is to meet that SLA.
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II required. We will likely start on Hosted to move quickly but need a clear path to VPC/Private within 6 months.
- Procurement: procurement@acmehealth.com is on copy for budget/PO discussions.

Budget guidance: we’re evaluating options but are sensitive to >$150k/month recurring cost. Can you show Hosted per-token vs Dedicated reserved commit scenarios? Also include an estimate for a Private VPC lift-and-shift (rough OPEX delta).

If you can send a comparison with assumptions (model, avg sequence length, batching assumptions) that would be ideal — we can review with procurement and come back with a target commit.

Thanks,
Samantha Green
Director, Product — Patient Experiences
AcmeHealth
Samantha.Green@acmehealth.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: AcmeHealth requirements — pricing scenarios request

Marissa — forwarding Samantha’s reply with Acme’s initial numbers (10M tokens/day, growth, SOC2, preference to start Hosted but need VPC roadmap). Can you run a short modeling exercise with the following scenarios and assumptions, then ?1-pager we can send to procurement: 

Requested scenarios:
A) Hosted API — per-token pricing: show monthly cost at current usage (300M tokens/month) and with +20% growth.
B) Dedicated (reserved capacity) — 3 commit tiers: low (50k USD/month), medium (150k USD/month), high (300k USD/month). Show equivalent per-token unit cost and expected throughput and whether 200ms p95 is achievable.
C) Private VPC (customer-managed) — high-level OPEX delta vs Dedicated and any one-time setup costs.

Assumptions to call out: model = redwood-medium-gpt (baseline), avg sequence length = 512 tokens, effective batching = 1.8x, percent chat vs embeddings = 90/10. Latency targets assume 99% of requests served from runtime with KV caching; cold-starts excluded. 

Attachments: I’ve included acme_pricing_scenarios.xlsx and a copy of redwood_dedicated_pricing_v2.pdf for reference. Please include line items we can share with procurement (monthly totals, unit price, commit term options, SLA notes). Need draft by Tuesday EOD so we can send to Acme for review.

Thanks — Aditya

Attachment: acme_pricing_scenarios.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB); redwood_dedicated_pricing_v2.pdf (PDF, 240KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T09:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: AcmeHealth requirements — pricing scenarios request

Aditya — thanks, ran the numbers and attached a short summary. High-level results (assumptions reiterated): model=redwood-medium-gpt, avg seq=512, batching=1.8x, 300M tokens/month baseline.

Summary (monthly costs, baseline usage 300M tokens):
- Hosted API (pay-as-you-go): approx $0.00040 per token -> ~ $120,000 / month
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): estimated total cost for medium tier (150k USD/month commit) -> ~ $85,000 / month effective (includes infra amortization + support). Achieves target 200ms p95 with our recommended autoscaling and 2x GPU pool; cost per token effectively ~ $0.00028 under baseline utilization.
- Private VPC (customer-managed): higher recurring infra & runbook costs — est. $120k–$160k/month + one-time setup ~ $60k (networking, audit connectors). Best for strict isolation/compliance but higher TCO.

Notes / caveats:
- All Dedicated estimates assume a 12-month commit; shorter terms increase unit costs.
- If Acme’s tokens grow 20% month-over-month, Hosted costs scale linearly; Dedicated shows improved unit economics as utilization rises.
- We recommend a launch on Hosted for speed + a committed Dedicated pilot (3–6 month ramp) to de-risk and secure better unit pricing. Offer to include SOC 2 evidence and a VPC migration plan in the commercial pack.

Next steps I propose:
1) Share attached 1-pager and the detailed spreadsheet with Acme procurement.
2) Book a 30-min pricing walkthrough with procurement to align on commit tiers and SLA.
3) If interested in Dedicated, we can scope a pilot (specific GPU profile and expected latency validation) and provide an MSA/redline-friendly commercial term sheet.

I’ve uploaded the full spreadsheet and 1-pager here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3Cacme-estimates

Will add a short note for procurement language after you get their target commit.

— Marissa Cole
Principal Pricing Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: acme_pricing_scenarios.xlsx (updated, 135KB); redwood_dedicated_pricing_v2.pdf (pricing summary)
